parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid value:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **20**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-check-item --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --lang zh --task-sources YAO_CHI --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ListCheckItem --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --CurrentPage 1 --TaskSources.1 YAO_CHI --Lang zh
